reproduce: BENCH_LIVE=1 UNDERSTUDY_ENV_FILE=<path to .env.local> COMPILE_MODELS=<model ids> COMPILE_RUNS=3 COMPILE_CONCURRENCY=3 node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/measure/compile-compare.test.ts --reporter=verbose (processes one after another; each merges its models into the file)

conditions.route: app/api/compile/route.ts POST, unchanged, with MODELS.nano set to the model compared; its client (vi.doMock of tokenFactory) guards and charges each call on the bench ledger, times out at 240 s with no SDK retry (the route: 25 s, one retry), and for a comparator replaces enable_thinking false with the model's own least-reasoning setting (scripts/compare-models.mjs)
conditions.specs: bench/specs/interview: 10 ground-truth specs and their degraded copies (bench/specs/interview/degraded), each through lib/sim/fit.ts fitToBench first, as the app compiles them
conditions.rehearsal: ground-truth programs only: lib/sim/interpreter.ts runToEnd at 1 g, sensed mode, nominal scene
conditions.model_asks: the final program's asks minus those the route added ('added an ask for'), plus those it dropped ('dropped an ask for')
conditions.prices: Nano from tests/fixtures/models.json, comparators from tests/fixtures/models-compare.json; a failed call is charged at its reserved worst case
